name: Khoai tay dai
summary: Khoai tây dài phủ sốt is fried potato sticks under a thick sauce. Vietnam Airlines says the sauce is often mayonnaise, cheese, or chili sauce, and prints 25,000–45,000 VND at 17 Trưng Nhị.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines lists it as a snack and prints 17 Trưng Nhị.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the potato crisp and the sauce rich. It names mayonnaise, cheese, or chili sauce as the usual coatings.
howToEat: The hour is Check on arrival.
where: 17 Trưng Nhị. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
